theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_rc_lintegral_le_liminf
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)), (∀ G : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen G → Bornology.IsBounded G → μ G ≤ liminf (fun j => μs j G) atTop) → ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → (∀ x, 0 ≤ g x) → ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (g x) ∂μ ≤ liminf (fun j => ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (g x) ∂(μs j)) atTop
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
